description: A test job. It waits seconds (0 to 600, default 5), then ends the way outcome says. It does not read or change tickets or settings. outcome completed returns the job. tool_error returns a result with isError true. failed returns a JSON-RPC error instead of a result. Declare io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks under params._meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities"].extensions and the call returns a task: poll tasks/get. In a task, tool_error still ends completed and failed ends failed. input_required asks for input first; answer with tasks/update and inputResponses.proceed. working never finishes: cancel it with tasks/cancel, or it expires after ttlMs. Without a task the request stays open for the whole wait, so seconds is at most 30, and input_required and working are refused. On that open request, a progressToken in params._meta gets notifications/progress once a second. A task reports the wait on tasks/get statusMessage. tasks/stream (SEP-2694, draft) replays that task's events and resumes with after. A job task emits io.github.markusvankempen.ticket.job.progress once a second.

label.description: Optional name, echoed in the result, e.g. retry-test.

outcome.description: How the job ends. completed (default), tool_error (isError result), failed (JSON-RPC error), input_required and working (inside a task only).

seconds.description: How long the job works, 0 to 600 seconds. Default 5. Without a task, at most 30.

name: run_test_job
